## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `bce074a03eebefeb051d139ccd0f2225a3ccff68`
Local-runs: probe — the seat ran the branch's self-tests from a `git archive` copy of the head (no checkout, no edit, no network): `post-stamped` 735/26, `issue-create` 56/8, `record-recognisers` 276/15, `fleet-write/dispatch` 260/23, `label-write` 136/11, `check-half-states` 5034, `check-prior-rulings` 155, `check-governed-queue-guard` 401, `mailbox-open` 45 — all exit 0 — and `post-stamped --dry-run` against six first lines (unsigned → exit 2 naming the shape; `domain:ui#1`, `repo:cloud#2`, `triage#1`, `director#1` forms → exit 0; a `cse_…` session → exit 2)
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/seat-post-protocol.md (one line in, one paid out), scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs (the signature reader and the first-line markers), scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs, scripts/pm/issue-create.mjs, scripts/pm/fleet-write/dispatch.mjs (the `comment_edit` / `issue_patch` door), scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs, scripts/pm/label-write.mjs, scripts/pm/check-prior-rulings.mjs, scripts/pm/with-fleet.sh + card #27113's 「Wanted」 1–5 and the maintainer's words quoted there

Read at 2026-10-28T13:33Z by the `domain:skills#2` seat on the fetched head (merge-base `9ff8154c`): nine files, +459/−36, 495 changed lines ≤ 3000. Tier S (`.claude/**` ×1 + non-gate `scripts/pm/**`; `check-governed-merges --pr 27263` lists the one `.claude` path). The claim's tier was the default (opus, no path mandate); this review is served at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`.

### ① Derived judgments

- The shape is the maintainer's 「车道#席位号 · 账户 · 会话」 exactly: `SEAT_SIGNATURE_LINE` = `(domain:|repo:|epic:#\d+|triage|director|coordinator)…#N · ACCOUNT · session_…`, separator ` · ` (U+00B7, the doorbell keys' separator), spelled ONCE in `check-half-states.mjs` (`readSignatureLine` / `stripSignatureLine` / `signatureRefusal`) and imported by the three writers and every recogniser — the dev moved it from the order's suggested home (`record-recognisers.mjs`) to the module that already owns the first-line markers, because the reverse import would close a top-level-await cycle; verified by reading the import graph on the head. One spelling, not three: holds.
- Wanted 2 (refuse, never auto-insert): `post-stamped.mjs` judges the signature in `main()` beside the stamp contract under the one `EXIT_REFUSED`, in `--comment` AND `--body` mode, before any request — dry run included; the refusal names the shape. `--sign-from` is not built (the card said MAY). Wanted 3: `issue-create.mjs` refuses an unsigned body as a plan error (exit 2); `fleet-write/dispatch.mjs` refuses unsigned `comment_edit` / `issue_patch` bodies in a seat's actions file (exit 2) with the fleet roster's generated body exempt by its imported `ROSTER_MARKER`; `pr_create` is out of scope (its line 1 is the closing keyword; the PR body says so) — the right reading of 「帖子」. Generated workflow cards untouched. Holds.
- Wanted 4: nine first-line readers in five files now skip one leading signature line (listed in the PR body with the ones that need nothing and why — the `m`-flag markers, the H64 head window, display-only rows); each named recogniser is pinned unsigned AND signed (22 new cases in `record-recognisers`, the seven mailbox keys included). An unsigned old post reads exactly as before (`stripSignatureLine` is a no-op without a signature). Holds.
- Wanted 5: `seat-post-protocol.md` L30 「帖与卡正文首行恒为署名 `LANE#N · ACCOUNT · SESSION`;缺即写工具拒发(`post-stamped.mjs` 头注)。」 (118 B ≤ 120), paid by deleting the 常设半边 line whose content lives at `dispatch-runbook.md` L41 and `seat-lifecycle.md` L37 (both read on the head); 88/88, no re-wrap. Holds.
- Fleet consequence, stated so no seat is surprised: from the merge on, every seat-authored comment, card body and seat-post refresh must open with the signature line; the triage seat already writes it by hand (its grade on #27151 opens `triage#1 · os-zhuang · session_…`), so the convention precedes the gate.

### ② Semver level

- None owed: PM scripts and protocol text; no package touched. `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none` on the PR body match the claim; no `Skills-docs:` line owed; `skip-changeset` correct.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Beyond the claim's named set, two writers still accept an unsigned body: a raw `comment` / `issue_create` op through the dispatch door (e.g. `mailbox-open.mjs`'s close comment) and `label-write`'s `Release:` comment — the dev left them at the card's boundary (Wanted 3 names three writers). Their readers already skip a signature. Noted under Acceptance notes; widening is a separate card if the maintainer wants it, not this PR's.
- `OS_DEV_REPORT_MARKER` keeps its `i` flag, so that one composed marker reads a signature case-insensitively on the read side; every writer refuses a mis-cased signature. Accepted.
- `with-fleet.sh` and `check-prior-rulings.mjs` are outside the claim's named list: `with-fleet.sh`'s `issue-create` dry-run fixture had to be signed (3 lines) and `check-prior-rulings` reads first content lines (5 lines) — both mechanical consequences of the rule, named in the PR body; the seat amends the claim's file surface by this record.
- Hypotheses 1, 3, 4 were refined by measurement (reader's home, refusal placement, per-recogniser pins instead of doubled fixtures) — each with a stated reason the seat verified; 2 and 5 held.
- Author `objectstack-fleet[bot]` through the relay; `mcp_calls: 0`; the dev's report comment was posted with `origin/main`'s tool (no signature required yet), as ordered.

### ④ Design judgment

- Against the maintainer's scenario (reading a reply and not knowing which lane, seat or account wrote it): the first line of every post now answers it, and a post that cannot answer it is never sent — refusal at the producer, one spelling, readers unchanged for the archive. Against the four-axis frame: AI-error (refuse, never tolerate or auto-insert), long-run (one reader module), focus (no gate, no patrol row, generated cards out). Holds. Residual: the two unsigned-capable writers above, and the mailbox-close comment's shape (`mailbox-open.mjs`) — both read fine, both can be widened later.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-27113-post-signature-line`
Reviewed-by: `session_01QSeKYmhU5KEj1nukYhp1Tg`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## 维护者速读 — 席位终稿 · PR #27263 · head `bce074a0` · `domain:skills#2` · 2026-10-28T13:42Z

- 改了什么:席位写的每条帖子、卡正文、座位贴正文,第一行必须是署名 `LANE#N · ACCOUNT · SESSION`(如 `domain:skills#2 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYmhU5KEj1nukYhp1Tg`);`post-stamped`(评论与正文两种模式)、`issue-create`、中继的 `comment_edit`/`issue_patch` 三个写口缺署名就拒发(退出码 2,印出格式,不自动补);九个按首行识别记录的读取器先跳过署名再识别,每个都钉了有/无署名两种;`seat-post-protocol.md` 加一行规则(88/88,付行有家)。
- 为什么改:你的原话「我看到回复,但是不知道是哪个账户回复的,哪个车道回复的」「同意 让发帖脚本 post-stamped 强制每条帖子第一行带署名…缺署名就拒发」。
- 风险与回滚:合并后每个席位第一次发帖会被拒一次(信息里有格式,补一行即可);旧帖识别结果不变(无署名时跳过逻辑是空操作);生成卡(full-run、flake 锚卡)不受影响。回滚 = revert。
- 先看:`scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` 的 `SEAT_SIGNATURE_LINE`(唯一拼写);`post-stamped.mjs` `main()` 的拒发分支;`fleet-write/dispatch.mjs` 的 `unsignedEditBodies`(名册豁免)。
- 两分钟验证:`printf 'hello\n' | node scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs --dry-run --comment=1 --repo=o/r` 预期退出 2 并印 「opens with no signature line」;首行加 `domain:skills#2 · os-justin · session_…` 再跑预期退出 0。
- 需要你做的:无 —— Tier S,席位契约复核 PASS(6470403263)后按你今天的落地授权落地。
- 席位意见:ACCEPT。九项自测从归档副本复跑全绿(735/56/276/260/136/5034/155/401/45);六种首行 dry-run 实测拒/收符合卡;分诊席已自发按此格式写首行(#27151 的定级),规则与现状一致。

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · `domain:skills#2` · `session_01QSeKYmhU5KEj1nukYhp1Tg` · 2026-10-28T13:42Z

1. 形态:draft → main,首行 `Fixes #27113`,`Clause-②: no`、`Metadata-protocol: none` 行首在;九个文件 +459/−36(495 行 ≤ 3000);assignee os-justin;`skip-changeset` 正确;`documentation`、`size/m` 为 bot 所加。
2. 前提实测:席位在取回的 head(merge-base `9ff8154c`)上核 —— 署名正则一处定义、三写口引用;新规则行 118 B、文件 88/88、付行之家在 `dispatch-runbook.md` L41 与 `seat-lifecycle.md` L37;`pr_create` 不在范围且正文说明;dry-run:未署名 exit 2,四种车道形态 exit 0,`cse_` 会话 exit 2。
3. 门禁 check-runs(head `bce074a0`,本笔读数 2026-10-28T13:42Z):51 check-runs,31 success · 20 skipped · 0 in progress · 0 failure(`mergeable_state: clean, draft`)。dev 本地派生 65/65 exit 0 钉 `bce074a0`(报告 6470286790)。
4. 接受的偏差:① 读取器落在 `check-half-states.mjs` 而非 `record-recognisers.mjs`(反向 import 成环,实测);② 拒发放在 `main()` 第二块而非戳契约编号表(`renderBody` 三处共享);③ 逐识别器有/无署名钉(22 例)而非翻倍全部夹具;④ `with-fleet.sh`、`check-prior-rulings.mjs` 越出认领面(机械随动,各 3/5 行),席位以本记录修正文件面;⑤ `--sign-from` 未建(卡为 MAY)。
5. 范围外去向:none filed;Acceptance notes:两处写口(中继裸 `comment`/`issue_create` op、`label-write` 的 `Release:` 评论)仍收未署名正文——读侧已跳过,要不要扩面是维护者的事;`OS_DEV_REPORT_MARKER` 保留 `i` 旗(读侧)。`Skills-docs:` 不欠(kind none)。
6. 落地条款:Tier S;契约复核 PASS 评论 6470403263(head `bce074a0`);全绿即席位经中继 `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable` 落地(本班维护者授权在案);MERGED 后关卡摘 `pm:dispatched`;**自合并起本席每条帖子首行加署名**。
